itemGroup.divine_encounters: Divine Encounters: Face of the Enemy
subtitles.divine_encounters.entity.visag: The Visage of War goes out
omen.divine_encounters.war.bound: You bind the omen, and you feel the thrill of the battle, belonging to someone long gone. Something will answer you in the fields of war..
omen.divine_encounters.malice.bound: You bind the omen, and an unresolved malice overwhelms you. Something awaits you in a dark forest..
omen.divine_encounters.refused.too_uneve: The ground here is too broken.
omen.divine_encounters.refused.obstructe: The ground here will not bear it.
omen.divine_encounters.refused.too_close: The last summoning still lingers nearby.
shrine.divine_encounters.found_triumph: The shrine finds triumph in your words.
shrine.divine_encounters.found_malice: The shrine finds malice in your words.
shrine.divine_encounters.too_soon: The shrine does not answer yet. (%s)
shrine.divine_encounters.refused.no_book: The lectern holds no signed prayer.
shrine.divine_encounters.refused.nothing: Nothing within your words takes shape.
shrine.divine_encounters.refused.too_div: The shrine remains silent. Your words pull two ways.
advancements.divine_encounters.root.desc: A lectern placed on top of a lodestone reveals the face of the enemy...
advancements.divine_encounters.visage_of: How do you stop something that is inevitable?
How do you define something that has no form?
omen.divine_encounters.drawn_by_kill: Something took notice of what you just did.
omen.divine_encounters.faded: %s loosens its hold on you, and is gone.
